name: Fusion conga sixteenths
desc: Busy fusion auxiliary percussion: conga sixteenth marcha with slap accents pushed off the grid, cabasa running underneath, cowbell euclid punctuation; built to sit inside a linear funk kit without fighting the snare.

gain.doc: level (vcsl perc is quiet - keep high)

code.full: stack(s("conga conga ~ conga conga ~ conga [conga conga] ~ conga conga ~ conga ~ conga conga").speed("[1 1.25 0 1 1.4 0 1 [1 .9] 0 1.25 1 0 1.4 0 1 .9]").speed(${spd}).gain("[.46 .26 0 .34 .4 0 .3 .38 0 .28 .34 0 .42 0 .3 .36]").shape(.45).pan(sine.range(.44,.56).slow(16)), s("cabasa*16").gain(saw.range(.09,.2).fast(4)).hpf(2600).pan(.62), s("cb(3,16,<2 6>)").gain(${gain}*.4).hpf(650).shape(.3).pan(.38)).fast(${rate}).room(.18).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("conga conga ~ conga conga ~ conga [conga conga] ~ conga conga ~ conga ~ conga conga").speed("[1 1.25 0 1 1.4 0 1 [1 .9] 0 1.25 1 0 1.4 0 1 .9]").speed(${spd}).gain("[.5 .3 0 .38 .44 0 .34 .42 0 .32 .38 0 .46 0 .34 .4]").shape(.5).pan(sine.range(.42,.58).slow(12)).every(4, x=>x.ply("1 1 1 1 1 1 1 2")), s("cabasa*16").gain(saw.range(.11,.24).fast(4)).hpf(2700).pan(.64), s("cb(5,16,<2 6>)").gain(${gain}*.44).hpf(650).shape(.35).pan(.36), s("~ ~ tb ~").gain(${gain}*.3).hpf(1400).pan(.7)).fast(${rate}).room(.18).orbit(2).play()
